title: Wall Mount Soap Dish Solid Brass 4.5-Inch Dottingham Collection Bath Accessory | Lavender | Allied Brass
description:

This Dottingham collection soap holder / soap dish accessory is crafted from solid brass and installs with concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look.

- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for an uncluttered appearance

Specs:
- Dimensions: 4.5 in L x 3.5 in W x 3 in H
- Projection: 5 in
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 1.6 lb

- Multiple designer finish options available
